reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, and a cartoon pet doesn't make that easier. My robo-adviser already does the boring part for a small fee, and I'm not signing up for a fourth subscription with no price and no broker named yet.
objection: An AI moving and paying with my real money is exactly the thing I don't want. A demo with fake money tells me nothing about what happens when it gets something wrong with my actual savings, and 'a licensed broker partner, later' isn't a name I can check.
would_change_my_mind: A named, regulated broker holding my money with insurance, a flat monthly fee clearly below what my robo-adviser costs me, and a long, public track record showing it didn't do anything stupid.
